main.help.title: AETHERION Help
main.help.body: To view data, start AETHERION Server and sign in to an authorized record. Emergency dispatch is not certified or operational. This is an independent research product, not a medical device.
main.footer.disclaimer: Not a medical device · Only source-verified data are displayed
main.landing.hint: Only real, source-attributed data with valid access permissions are displayed.
main.landing.monitor.title: Monitoring & ECG
main.landing.monitor.body: Measurements require a paired, authorized real source. No ECG waveform is shown before a valid recording is imported.
main.landing.assistant.title: Ask Health AI
main.landing.assistant.body: Local/cloud AI has not yet been verified as operational on the server. You can read imported scientific records and inspect their sources.
main.landing.atlas.title: Explore Anatomy
main.landing.atlas.body: The 3D anatomy viewer will open only when real meshes, a camera and body-region picking are available. Decorative animation is not a 3D atlas.
main.landing.care.title: Care Journey
main.landing.care.body: Gather → Evaluate → Act → Recheck must be persisted on the server and follow verified clinical rules.
mission.subtitle: Monitor records with traceable source, timestamp and identity. Never infer health status without evidence.
mission.authHint: Sign in with a local server account. Credentials are not stored in the UI.
mission.statusInitial: NOT AUTHENTICATED · No health status inferred
mission.technicalDisclaimer: Device status and clinical reports are different types of events. Missing connections or records do not indicate an emergency.
personal.title: My Health
personal.lead: A source-traceable overview of measurements and timestamps. You do not need to enter symptoms unless you choose to.
personal.noSubject: No record selected — sign in under Crew
personal.noProvenance: No valid record available for this subject
personal.filteredNoData: No records match the current filter
personal.disclaimer: Symptom entry is optional. Missing readings prove neither normal nor abnormal health; NASA research data are not live vital signs.
personal.deniedInvalid: DENIED — invalid subject or missing session
personal.deniedChoose: DENIED — select a subject from Mission Control and sign in
personal.invalidProvenance: ERROR — latest metric provenance is invalid
personal.noteMore: Showing the newest record per metric, scope and unit from the latest 50 server observations. More history is available.
personal.noteLatest: Newest recorded value per metric, scope and unit. Older records remain on the server; missing readings are not normal readings.
